chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: Working at Cafe Society with J. C. Heard and meeting Sarah Vaughan
summary: About a year at Cafe Society with J. C. Heard's band, where Jones first met Sarah Vaughan.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So we just -- of course I went -- we began to split up. I went and started working at Cafe Society. I stayed there maybe a year, a year and a half or so.
Whom were you working with there?

Well, it was J. C. Heard, he had the band, and there was Dicky Wells, the trombone player, and Al McKibbon, the bass player. Let's see, who was -- Bud Johnson, the tenor player. And that's where I first met Sarah Vaughan.
